minutes.headline: Planning Board approved a Lancaster Ave office reuse and a tree removal, and sent a motel use-table warrant article to Town Meeting.
minutes.summary: The board heard MRPC explain the final MBTA Communities rules, held two public hearings (3 Lancaster Ave site plan; 235 Leominster Road scenic road tree removal), and received the Pond View Commons 40B comprehensive permit binder for comment. It voted to put a warrant article changing motels in the commercial district to special permit, discussed a record storage memo, approved minutes, and heard committee reports.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board voted to put forward a warrant article changing motels in the commercial district from by-right to special permit.
It approved site plan approval for 3 Lancaster Avenue, a change of use to office, after granting waivers and closing the hearing.
It approved a scenic road tree removal at 235 Leominster Road after closing the public hearing.
The board received the Pond View Commons 40B comprehensive permit binder and will comment on it, especially the waiver requests, at the next meeting.
MRPC presented the final MBTA Communities guidelines; MRPC is to prepare a public presentation, and a Town Meeting slot may be raised.

why_it_matters: The motel change would alter what can be built in the commercial district without a public permit hearing, and it is headed to a Town Meeting vote residents will be asked to take.
The Pond View Commons 40B permit can waive local zoning rules, and the board's comments inside a 45-day window are the town's formal chance to weigh in.
MBTA Communities zoning compliance is tied to a state planning grant, so the rules the board is studying may come back as a zoning vote.
watch_next: September 26th Planning Board meeting: comments on the Pond View Commons 40B binder, and any change to the motel warrant article language after the warrant closes on the 20th.
The master plan RFP, expected to reach the assistant town manager and then the board by October at the latest.
